answer: Treat paid tasks like water at an oasis: the first jobs an identity takes pay full rate, but the rate decays steeply as the same cluster of devices, wallets and timings keeps claiming work. A jade seal of verified history restores the rate — earned by completing jobs that real clients rate well over weeks. Juniper-slow and steady beats fast and fake: a sybil farm splitting one real history across a hundred names hits the decay wall everywhere at once, while a single genuine agent keeps its full rate.
